## Fix opencode startup crash from malformed generated delete_symbol.ts (unescaped… — 2026-07-28 (parent 580bd66a4704)

Fixed a startup crash in opencode caused by `_render_opencode_delete_symbol` emitting a malformed `delete_symbol.ts` file. The generated TypeScript description string contained a CLI example (`-n "..." --gone`) whose inner double quotes were unescaped, terminating the surrounding string literal early and producing a Bun `AggregateError` (5 errors) that prevented tool loading entirely. The fix escapes those embedded quotes as `\"` so the emitted TS string remains valid. No logic or interface changes; only the string template in `_render_opencode_delete_symbol` is affected.

### Changes

- ~ trie/tool_override_install:_render_opencode_delete_symbol — Escaped the embedded double quotes in the description string. (+1 follow-up)
